notes.title: CapRiders comes OUT of Early Acces!
notes.notes:
CapRiders is finally coming out of Early Access! It took us some extra time but we wanted to make sure that the online multiplayer experience was enjoyable and stable.

We have also fixed several issues and bugs, updated AI behavior, added difficulty levels and reworked a few gameplay mechanics.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Online Multiplayer mode added: Room based online multiplayer, up to 8 players per match and up to 4 players per PC.
[*]Added support for macOS.
[*]AI Difficulty settings: AI bots can be set to Easy, Medium or Hard in the match settings window.
[*]3 new Ball types added
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved AI behaviour
[*]Various gameplay improvements and fixes based on user feedback
[*]Slow-mo reworked
[*]Re-tuning of player forces and movements
[/list]

notes.title: CapRiders has been finally released on Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and once again thank you for your great support!

We're really excited to show you and let you play our game! We'd like to remind everyone that all kind of feedback is really appreciated.

Tell us what you like, what you don't like, what you'd like to see and anything else that comes to your mind.

See you on the field!
